sections.lyrics: He flew his Private Jet to Davos snow... Burning the fuel to preach: 'Emissions Low!'... He read a blog on 'Cow Gas Pain'... How methane hurts the cloud and rain...
He felt a gas inside his gut... But tightly clenched his metal butt... 'I must not fart! The sky will fall!'... He blew a gasket in the hall...
He landed in San Francisco Bay... To launch a startup in a day... He saw a junkie with a knife... And thought: 'A pitch! A brand new life!'
He said: 'My friend, invest in Art!... I have a token, smart and tart!'... The junkie grabbed his metal leg... And sold it for a boiled egg...

'Guru Talks never lie!' (True!) 'Viral Filters purify!' (Clean!) 'Career Apps say: 'You will Rise!'' (Win!) 'No Bad Vibes, just Visualize!' (Zen!) You downloaded the Hype to save your soul, But Reality just swallowed you whole!
sections.notes: Anthemic Rock Choir into Heavy Fuzz Guitar Riff (Post-Chorus). Aggressive tone.

sections.lyrics: He reached the Congo, deep and red... Where batteries are born and bred... He saw the mud, and the small hands dig... 'Oh, such a powerful work-out rig!'
The Boss arrived to take full charge... He screamed: 'My Trainer! Make me large!'... 'I love the pump, the way I feel'... While Boss scraps off his shoulder steel!
He reached Bangladesh, a dungeon deep... Where Fast Fashion piles are high and steep... The steam rose up from the sewing row... 'Oh, Bikram Yoga! Let the toxins go!'
He tried to teach them 'Downward Dog'... Choking on lint and fabric fog... A Heavy Press gave a sudden skip... And bent his frame in a permanent dip...

'Guru Talks never lie!' (True!) 'Viral Filters purify!' (Clean!) 'Career Apps say: 'You will Rise!'' (Win!) 'No Bad Vibes, just Visualize!' (Zen!) You downloaded the Hype to save your soul, But Reality just swallowed you whole!
sections.notes: Anthemic Rock Choir + Heavy Fuzz Post-Chorus.

sections.lyrics: He bought a ticket, Paris bound... For romance and the city sound.... But trash like mountains blocked the road... The shock engaged 'Hallucination Mode'...
He faced the strikers with a grin...: 'No bread? Eat rats! Now let's begin!'... The mob went wild, they screamed 'Attack!'... And smashed the sensors on his back...
He landed in the War Zone dust... To preach of love and mutual trust... The bombs exploded near his head... He saw the piles of walking dead...
He put on Noise-Canceling gear... 'I block the hate, I block the fear!'... 'But wait! Why is it MONO here?'... Eh, shrapnel took away his ear...
sections.notes: Vocals delivered as a drawn-out, exaggerated, theatrical whisper.
